titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Sir Garfield Sobers, a West Indies cricket player, has died.
Iceberg lettuce at Taco Bell is linked to a cyclospora outbreak affecting 5 states.

titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: A school bus crash in Uganda resulted in at least 20 deaths.
Chancellor Friedrich Merz of Germany and President Emmanuel Macron of France plan closer nuclear cooperation.
At least one person died in flooding in Texas in an area where campers previously died.
